<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[2024 Israeli invasion of Lebanon]]
***[[2024 Israel–Lebanon ceasefire agreement]]
****A 60-day [[ceasefire]] between [[Israel]] and [[Hezbollah]] takes effect. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israel-hezbollah-ceasefire-takes-effect-2024-11-27/ (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c0mze4pzdnlo (BBC News)]
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]], [[Killing of journalists in the Israel–Hamas war]]
***Seventeen people, including one journalist, are killed in [[Israel]]i strikes on the [[Kamal Adwan Hospital]] in [[Beit Lahia]] and the [[Nuseirat refugee camp]] in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.newarab.com/news/israeli-strikes-gaza-kill-17-lebanon-ceasefire-holds (''The New Arab'')] [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/another-journalist-killed-in-israeli-attack-in-gaza-death-toll-rises-to-190/3406244 (Anadolu Agency)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/28/nine-members-of-a-family-killed-in-nuseirat-as-israel-bombards-gaza (Al Jazeera)]
**[[United States support for Israel in the Israel–Hamas war]]
***The [[Joe Biden administration]] provisionally approves a $680 million military arms package to [[Israel]], including hundreds of [[GBU-39 Small Diameter Bomb|small diameter bombs]] and thousands of [[Joint Direct Attack Munition|JDAMs]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/27/biden-oks-680m-israel-arms-sale-despite-new-gaza-ceasefire-push-reports (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[2024 Syrian opposition offensives]]
***[[Syrian opposition]] forces led by [[Tahrir al-Sham]] attack the pro-government [[Syrian Army]] in western [[Aleppo Governorate]], capturing eleven towns and villages. [https://www.aljazeera.net/news/2024/11/27/%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B9%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%B6%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%B7%D9%84%D9%82-%D8%B9%D9%85%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%B1%D8%AF%D8%B9 (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.syriahr.com/%d8%a8%d8%b9%d8%af-%d8%a3%d8%b3%d8%a7%d8%a8%d9%8a%d8%b9-%d9%85%d9%86-%d9%86%d8%b4%d8%b1-%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%85%d8%b1%d8%b5%d8%af-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%b3%d9%88%d8%b1%d9%8a-%d9%84%d9%84%d8%a7%d8%b3%d8%aa%d8%b9/738073/ (SOHR)]
**[[Rojava conflict]]
***[[Autonomous Administration of North and East Syria|Rojavan Kurdish insurgents]] launch a raid on Turkish-[[Syrian National Army]] positions in [[Manbij]], Aleppo Governorate, Syria, although no casualties are reported. [https://www.syriahr.com/en/349987/ (SOHR)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*The [[City of London Corporation]] proposes a bill to close the 19th-century [[Billingsgate Fish Market]] in [[Billingsgate]] and [[Smithfield, London|Smithfield Meat Market]] in [[Smithfield, London|Smithfield]], [[City of London]], [[United Kingdom]], by 2028. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cje050wz22qo (BBC News)] [https://apnews.com/article/smithfield-billingsgate-london-closure-britain-markets-9e002da94245f004a97ca7a80a0caa41 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[United States–Venezuela relations]], [[2024 Venezuelan political crisis]]
**The [[United States]] imposes sanctions on 21 [[Venezuela]]n [[Government of Venezuela|officials]], including [[Ministry of Communication and Information (Venezuela)|information minister]] [[Freddy Ñáñez]] and [[Cabinet of Venezuela|planning minister]] [[Ricardo Menéndez (politician)|Ricardo Menéndez]], for suppressing the [[2024 Venezuelan protests|protests]] against the results of the [[2024 Venezuelan presidential election|presidential election in July]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/us-slaps-sanctions-on-venezuelan-officials/a-70903800 (DW)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Killing of Yuval Castleman]]
**The [[Israel Defense Forces]] indicts Sgt. Aviad Frija with reduced [[manslaughter]] after he shot and killed [[Yuval Castleman]] after mistaking Castleman for a [[Hamas]] militant during the [[7 October attacks]]. [https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-831120 (''The Jerusalem Post'')] 
*[[Rohingya genocide]], [[War crimes during the Myanmar civil war (2021–present)|War crimes during the Myanmar civil war]]
**[[Prosecutor of the International Criminal Court|Prosecutor]] of the [[International Criminal Court]] [[Karim Ahmad Khan]] applies for an [[arrest warrant]] for [[Myanmar]]'s [[Tatmadaw|military]] leader and [[Chairman of the State Administration Council]] [[Min Aung Hlaing]] for [[crimes against humanity]] relating to the deportation and persecution of the [[Rohingya]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/nov/27/international-criminal-court-prosecutor-seeks-arrest-warrant-myanmar-military-leader-min-aung-hlaing (''The Guardian'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Constitutional crisis in Somalia]]
**[[2024 Jubaland presidential election]]
***The Banadir Regional Court in [[Mogadishu]], [[Somalia]], issues an arrest warrant for [[List of presidents of Jubaland|Jubaland President]] [[Ahmed Madobe]], accusing Madobe of [[treason]] and violating the [[Constitution of Somalia|constitution]]. In response, the regional court in [[Kismayo]], [[Jubaland]], announces a $100,000 [[Bounty (reward)|reward]] for the arrest of [[President of Somalia|Somali President]] [[Hassan Sheikh Mohamud]], accusing Hassan of treason, undermining national unity, and conspiring with [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al-Shabaab militia]]. [https://www.barrons.com/articles/somali-court-issues-arrest-warrant-for-jubaland-leader-345b9789 (AFP)] [https://www.idilnews.com/jubaland-regional-court-issues-arrest-warrant-for-president-hassan-sheikh-mohamud-on-charges-of-treason/ (''Idili News'')] [https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2024/Nov/199096/tit_for_tat_arrest_warrants_escalate_somalia_jubaland_political_crisis.aspx (Hiiraan Online)]
*[[2024 Indonesian local elections]]
**[[Indonesia]]ns vote for governors, regents, and mayors in the country's first simultaneous local elections. [https://www.cnnindonesia.com/nasional/20241127061900-617-1171008/live-report-pilkada-serentak-2024 (CNN Indonesia)]
*[[2024 Namibian general election]]
**[[Namibians]] vote in the first round of the general election between 14 candidates for [[President of Namibia|President]], and also vote for the 96 members of the [[National Assembly (Namibia)|National Assembly]]. [https://apnews.com/article/namibia-election-vote-woman-swapo-da175a3b3021bc19eb1db85d548a0fe0 (AP)] [https://www.dw.com/en/namibian-election-swapo-faces-new-challenges-in-tight-race/a-70890329 (DW)]
